name: browser-device-stage
description: A generic app surface in token-native device chrome (browser, window, or phone). The screen is a slot for caller img/video/HTML with a token-styled skeleton default; one settle entrance, a readable hold, and an optional screen swap.

vars.description: Device frame drawn around the screen slot.
Address pill text (browser) or title bar text (window).
Seconds from mount start to swap to the second screen. 0 disables the swap.
Token the skeleton accent elements ride.
Optional departure. None holds the final frame.
